title: Sharing Agents Across Booths, Dispatch & Office Staff
summary: Master the Two-Lock Rule so every shift can open your agent AND read the underlying SharePoint SOPs without permission errors.

intro.what: How to share an agent safely with your team while protecting sensitive enforcement or HR files.
intro.features: Copilot checks both the Agent Share Link (Lock 1) and the user's SharePoint file access (Lock 2).
intro.exchange: Never link private supervisor mailboxes or restricted scofflaw/HR folders to a general staff agent.
intro.m365: Put all shared handbooks and detour schedules in a team SharePoint library where all Parking & Transit staff have View access.
intro.developer: Manage group sharing scope in Agent Builder Share settings.
sources: Microsoft · Share and manage agents in Agent Builder

sections.title: The Two-Lock Rule in Plain English
paragraphs: Lock 1 is the Agent Link—who is allowed to open the agent chat screen. Lock 2 is SharePoint File Permissions—which files Microsoft 365 allows that person to read. If you store Parking-Transit-Handbook.txt in your personal OneDrive and forget to share it, coworkers will open the agent and see 'No information found.' Move team knowledge files into your shared Parking & Transit SharePoint folder first!
sources: Microsoft · Share and manage agents in Agent Builder

title: Team Rollout & Semester Refresh Checklist
summary: A four-step rollout habit so booth attendants, field supervisors, and office coordinators adopt your agents smoothly.

intro.what: A repeatable launch and maintenance checklist for Parking & Transportation teams.
intro.features: Solo 3-question test -> 2-shift Buddy Pilot -> Teams channel pin -> Semester/Event file refresh.
intro.exchange: Test ambiguous appeal and overflow cases before launching department-wide.
intro.m365: Assign a primary owner and one backup editor so rate or detour updates never wait on one person.
intro.developer: Re-run golden test questions whenever policy documents are revised.
sources: Microsoft · Manage and update your agents

sections.title: Four Steps to a Smooth Team Launch
paragraphs: 1. Solo Smoke Test: Test 1 normal rate question, 1 Sunday/ADA edge case, and 1 unlisted question.
2. Buddy Pilot: Share with 1 booth attendant and 1 dispatcher for 24 hours. Add local lot nicknames (like 'North Deck' = Garage 2) to Instructions.
3. Team Launch: Pin the link in your Operations Teams channel with 3 starter prompts.
4. Semester & Event Refresh: Replace expired detour maps in SharePoint and archive old versions.

rows: Verify Rule ID citations & refusal to guess
Confirm SharePoint access & add local lot nicknames
Pin in Teams + share 3 starter prompts
Archive old detour PDFs; re-test 3 sample prompts
